**Core Innovation:** The research introduces a novel framework for industrial computer vision AI standards, focusing on enhancing accuracy and reliability in object detection and tracking through advanced algorithmic optimizations and standardized protocols.

**Technical Approach:**
- Enhanced neural network architectures incorporating convolutional layers for feature extraction.
- Implement adaptive thresholding techniques to improve detection reliability.
- Integration of real-time tracking algorithms for seamless operation in dynamic environments.
- Utilization of cloud-based AI platforms for scalable and efficient processing.
- Development of a comprehensive evaluation metric suite for performance assessment.

**Quantitative Findings:**
- The optimized model achieved a detection accuracy of **98.5%** on benchmark datasets.
- Real-time tracking performance maintained a latency of **<100ms** per frame.
- Standardized protocols reduced system downtime by **15%** in field trials.
- Evaluation metrics indicated a **20% improvement** in false positive rates.
- The framework successfully reduced operational costs by **12%** through optimized resource allocation.

**Limitations & Assumptions:**
- The model assumes consistent lighting conditions during deployment.
- Reliance on high-quality training datasets for optimal performance.
- Limited testing in extreme environmental conditions may affect accuracy.
- The framework may require significant computational resources for high-throughput applications.
- Assumption that domain experts can adapt the framework to their specific needs.

**Domain Impact (theoretical/practical):**
The proposed framework significantly advances industrial computer vision by introducing scalable, efficient, and standardized AI solutions. Practically, it can enhance productivity and precision in manufacturing and automation sectors. Theoretically, it provides a benchmark for future research in AI-driven vision systems.
